summary: Focused frontend re-test of 3 fixes + 1 regression on the High On AI portal (Next.js + FastAPI). FIX1: registered brand-new user qanew589935@example.com via marketing AuthModal (auth-mode-signup) -> redirected to /portal with onboarding-overlay count = 0, zero 'growth 360' text, scan-url-input visible/clickable/typable and scan-start-button present (no modal to skip). FIX2: at 390x844 logged in as seeded user, portal-view-site-mobile and portal-logout-mobile are both visible in the topbar; clicking portal-logout-mobile logged the user out and returned to the marketing site (/) with marketing nav rendered. FIX3: chat-launcher and onboarding-overlay counts are 0 on /portal, /portal/leads, /portal/pages and on a public generated page /p?slug=roadmap-release-and-enterprise-issue-tracking-for--4e9ba5 (verified via computed-style fixed-element scan too). REGRESSION: /portal/leads at 390x844 renders leads-table with the 1 seeded lead; filter row stacks (leads-search full width 308px, spam toggle + export on a second row, no horizontal document overflow: scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). No LLM scan/generate triggered, no Razorpay, no Regenerate confirm triggered.

issues: Floating hero chips (e.g. 'Voice AI') extend past the right edge of the viewport and are clipped - purely cosmetic, no document-level horizontal scroll observed on portal pages
Leads table itself still scrolls horizontally (the 'Answers/Notes' column is cut off); acceptable as table overflow-x but consider a stacked card layout on mobile

critical_code_review_comments: providers.jsx MarketingOverlays uses pathname.startsWith('/p') to suppress overlays - this is a prefix match that would also silence Onboarding/ChatBot on any future marketing route beginning with 'p' (e.g. /pricing, /partners). Prefer pathname === '/p' || pathname.startsWith('/p?') || pathname.startsWith('/p/').
